text: ‘Why, ma’am, it was simple enough; he pulled the trigger with his big toe. He layed over on his side and put the end of the barrel in his mouth, then he drew up one foot and felt for the trigger. He found it all right!’ ‘Maybe he did,’ said Jake grimly. ‘There’s something mighty queer about it.’ ‘Now what do you mean, Jake?’ grandmother asked sharply. ‘Well, ma’m, I found Krajiek’s axe under the manger, and I picks it up and carries it over to the corpse, and I take my oath it just fit the gash in the front of the old man’s face.
